blocks.content:
• Article 370 was effectively removed in 2019.
• Jammu & Kashmir reorganized into two UTs:
✔ Jammu & Kashmir (with legislature)
✔ Ladakh (without legislature)

Extremely important for exams.

items: Crucial distinction for exams: Jammu & Kashmir has a legislature, while Ladakh does not.
Remember the reorganisation year (2019) and its relation to the effective removal of Article 370.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 370 was effectively removed in the year 2019.
Jammu & Kashmir was reorganized into two separate Union Territories.
Jammu & Kashmir was formed as a Union Territory with a legislature.
Ladakh was formed as a Union Territory without a legislature.
